attack.description: Settings every attack plugin shares: the pause between attacks and the most attacks a day.
attackBarronsGreatEmpire.description: Attacks Robber Baron castles in the Great Empire again and again, with the commanders you allow.
attackBarronsBurningSands.description: Attacks Robber Baron castles in Burning Sands again and again, with the commanders you allow.
attackBarronsEverWinterGlacier.descripti: Attacks Robber Baron castles in Everwinter Glacier again and again, with the commanders you allow.
attackBarronsFirePeaks.description: Attacks Robber Baron castles in Fire Peaks again and again, with the commanders you allow.
attackBerimondInvasion.description: Attacks during the Berimond Invasion event, and uses event tools to earn points.
attackBloodcrows.description: Attacks Bloodcrow camps during the Bloodcrow event, with glory banners and siege tools, until the event ends or the score you set is reached.
attackForeign.description: Attacks Foreign Lords' camps during the Foreign Invasion event, with glory banners and siege tools, until the event ends or the score you set is reached.
attackFortressesBurningSands.description: Attacks the fortresses in Burning Sands with the commanders you allow.
attackFortressesEverWinterGlacier.descri: Attacks the fortresses in Everwinter Glacier with the commanders you allow.
attackFortressesFirePeaks.description: Attacks the fortresses in Fire Peaks with the commanders you allow.
attackKhan.description: Attacks Khan camps during the Khan event until it ends or the score you set is reached.
attackNomads.description: Attacks Nomad camps during the Nomad event until it ends or the score you set is reached.
attackSamurai.description: Attacks Samurai camps during the Samurai event until it ends or the score you set is reached.
attackDaimyo.description: Attacks the Daimyo castles of the ranks you pick during a Samurai event that has them, until the event ends.
daimyoRank1: Rank 1 (weakest, 30 min wait rising to 2 h)
daimyoRank2: Rank 2 (1 h wait rising to 5 h)
daimyoRank3: Rank 3 (2 h wait rising to 10 h)
daimyoRank4: Rank 4 (strongest, 5 h wait rising to 25 h)
attackDaimyo.daimyoRank1.help: Daimyo castles of levels 81 to 90 on the classic difficulty. Each attack makes the next wait 30 min longer, up to 2 h.
attackDaimyo.daimyoRank4.help: Daimyo castles of levels 116 to 120 on the classic difficulty. Send a strong army: the bot does not check whether an attack can win.
attackDaimyo.targetMode.help: Cycle mode with time skips attacks every Daimyo castle of the ranks you pick in turn and skips each wait. Cycle mode without skips attacks only castles whose wait is over. Skip mode attacks the one castle at the coordinates below, whatever its rank. Time skips are skip items only, never rubies.
attackDaimyo.skipTypes.help: Untick the first box to pick the time skips this plugin alone may spend. A rank 4 castle's wait can reach 25 h, so leave the large skips on if you want those castles skipped.
attackDaimyo.tools.help: Wave 1 tools are the wall, gate and shield tools of the first wave. Samurai event tools cannot attack a Daimyo castle, so the bot never sends them here. No tools sends troops only.
attackDaimyo.sourceCastle.help: The castle the attacks leave from, and the one the bot looks for Daimyo castles around. Left empty, the bot uses your main castle.
attackStormForts.description: Attacks the fortresses on the Storm Islands at the levels you pick, and can spend aquamarine before your store fills up.
autoStation.description: When a player attacks one of your castles, moves its troops to a protected alliance castle just before the attack lands, then calls them home.
buyTools.description: Buys siege tools from the armourer with coins whenever a castle holds fewer than the minimum you set.
aquaIsland.description: Keeps one Discord message up to date with the free Aquamarine Islands, their size and when each opens.
aquaTower.description: Keeps one Discord message up to date with the Aquamarine Towers, their level and the hits left on each.
chat.description: Copies your alliance chat to a Discord channel and sends what you write there back to the game.
fortress.description: Keeps one Discord message up to date with the fortresses in Burning Sands, Everwinter Glacier and Fire Peaks and the time left on each.
incomingAttacks.description: Posts a Discord message when a player attacks you, with who, where and how long until it lands.
outgoingAttacks.description: Posts your own attacks in a Discord channel, with where they go and when they land.
slashCommands.description: Adds Discord slash commands for looking up highscores, players and alliances.
feast.description: Starts feasts in your castles when they hold more food than you need. It skips the Storm Islands and Berimond.
helpRequests.description: Asks your alliance for help when the game offers it, after a short random wait.
loginBonus.description: Claims your daily login bonus once a day, picking the reward you prefer from the three on offer.
loginBonus.loginBonusReward.help: The game offers three rewards a day, a different three each day. The bot takes this kind when it is on offer. Otherwise it goes down the list: VIP time or VIP points, troops, time skips, resources, decorations.
meadReplaceStorm.description: Sends mead from your Great Empire main castle to your Storm Islands castle so it doesn't run out.
sellStoredEquipment.description: Sells loose equipment and gems from your storage, a few at a time. It never sells relic or unique equipment, or anything that belongs to a set.
shutoffTimer.description: Stops the bot after the number of hours you set.
skips.description: Decides which time skips the other plugins may spend. It is always on.
taxCollector.description: Sends your tax collector out for 10 minutes and collects the taxes when it is back, again and again.
toolsmith.description: Builds siege and defence tools in your workshops until each one reaches the stock you set.
attack.attackDelaySeconds.help: The shortest pause between two attacks.
attack.attackDelayRandomizationSeconds.h: Each pause is picked at random between the seconds above and that plus this number, so attacks don't come on a fixed beat.
attack.attackLimit.help: The bot stops attacking for the day at this many attacks. The game's own daily limit still applies.
feast.feastType.help: Each feast has its own food cost and a range of levels it is for. The cost comes from the feast, so there is nothing to type. Automatic picks the dearest food feast your level allows. Ruby feasts are never used.
feast.feastCastles.help: Add the castles that should feast, each paying with its own food. With none added, every castle feasts. Storm Islands and Berimond castles never feast.
attackBarronsGreatEmpire.deleteReports.h: Deletes the battle reports of this plugin's own won attacks. Lost attacks keep their reports.

feast.minimumFoodRate.help: A castle feasts only if its food income, after what its people eat, is at least this much.
helpRequests.fastHelp.help: Asks after 1 to 5 seconds instead of 1 to 2 minutes. It is quicker, but looks less like a person.
chat.hideDiscordName.help: Sends your Discord messages to the game chat without your Discord name in front.
incomingAttacks.stormChannelID.help: Attacks on the Storm Islands are posted here instead of in the first channel.
sellStoredEquipment.sellRarities.help: An item is sold only if both its rarity and its slot are ticked. Untick Epic and Legendary to keep those. Relic and unique equipment and set pieces are never sold. Hero equipment counts under the same rarities.
sellStoredEquipment.sellGemMaxLevel.help: Gems above this level are kept. Gems that belong to a set are never sold.
sellStoredEquipment.sellMaxPerRun.help: The bot sells every 5 minutes, up to this many items at a time.
skips.bypassSkipTypeFilter.help: Normally the bot won't use a skip that is more than four times longer than the wait. Turn this on to allow it.
attackStormForts.buyCoins.help: Buys it with aquamarine when your store is nearly full.
attackStormForts.buyXP.help: Buys it with aquamarine when your store is nearly full.
attackStormForts.resourceSend.help: Needs the Storm Islands to be unlocked.
toolsmith.targets.help: Pick a tool and how many to keep in stock. The workshops build tools until your castles together hold that many.
buyTools.targets.help: Pick a castle, a tool and the least you want in stock there. When the castle holds fewer, the bot buys the shortfall from the armourer, plus the extra tools below. A minimum of 0 buys nothing. The game delivers a purchase to the kingdom, not to a chosen castle, so for a castle that isn't the main one the bot stops buying if a purchase doesn't show up there.
autoStation.stationLeadSeconds.help: The troops leave this long before the attack lands. If it is too short, they may not get out in time.
autoStation.stationDestination.help: Auto picks an alliance castle whose owner still has enough protection left. Fixed tries your list in order.
autoStation.stationGateFallback.help: Opening the gates costs rubies, from 450 to 56,700 each time, and more every time you do it. They stay open for the hours you pick, and never in Berimond.
autoStation.stationGateMaxRubies.help: The gates open only if one opening costs no more than this.
autoStation.stationHours.help: Stationing for 12 hours or less is free.

attackNomads.targetMode.help: Skip mode attacks the one camp at the coordinates below and spends time skips on its wait. Cycle mode takes every Nomad camp near the castle in turn and attacks only camps whose wait is over, so it spends no time skips. Cycle mode with time skips is what this module always did: every camp in turn, skipping each wait.

attackKhan.armyMode.help: Autofill lets the bot pick troops and tools by the options below. Waves sends exactly the waves you write.
attackKhan.rageWaves.help: How many waves after the first carry rage tools. Rage fills the Khan's rage bar, which calls his attack on your castle.
attackKhan.boosterWaves.help: How many waves after the rage waves carry tablet chests, which multiply the tablets you loot. Waves beyond both counts carry troops only.
attackKhan.rageTools.help: Leave this empty and the bot takes the strongest rage tools first. Add tools and the rage waves use only these, in this order.
attackKhan.tabletChests.help: Leave this empty and the bot takes the strongest tablet chests first. Add tools and the chest waves use only these, in this order.
attackKhan.tabletsOnly.help: The bot still attacks the camp for tablets, but never calls the Khan's attack on your castle when the rage bar is full.
attackKhan.pauseAtTaunts.help: 0 turns this off. While this many Khan attacks are heading for your castle, the bot sends no new hits. Hits already on their way still land.
attackKhan.tauntMinDefenders.help: 0 turns this off. Before each taunt the bot reads your main castle. It needs at least this many defensive troops in the castle, and at least 10 tools in every wall slot on the sides you defend. Sides with no tools are not checked. If it falls short, the taunt is held and the bot checks again in 5 minutes. Hits go on meanwhile.
attackKhan.keepDefence.help: Refills the walls, gate, moat and courtyard of your main castle after each Khan attack lands, back to the layout they held when the plugin started, with tools from storage. Set the defence in the game first.
attackKhan.stockFlamingArrows.help: 0 buys nothing. When your main castle holds fewer than this, the bot buys 1,000 from the armourer.
attackKhan.stockHurlingRocks.help: 0 buys nothing. When your main castle holds fewer than this, the bot buys 1,000 from the armourer.

attackKhan.armourerSpendCap.help: The bot checks the stock about every 30 minutes and never spends more coins than this in one check.
attackKhan.armourerCoinFloor.help: The bot buys no defence tools that would leave you with fewer coins than this.
attackKhan.unitOrder.help: Which troops the bot takes first when it fills an attack. Castle order keeps the bot's own order: ranged troops lead the first wave, and the weakest troops fill the later waves.
attackKhan.supply.help: Which troops autofill may take, by what they eat.
attackKhan.dryRun.help: Builds each attack and writes it to the log. It sends no attack, no time skip, no taunt and no armourer order.

attackStormForts.buySkips5h.help: 50 skips for 40,000 aquamarine. The shop sells 10 of this package, and the bot never asks for more in one session.
attackStormForts.buySkips24h.help: 10 skips for 40,000 aquamarine. The shop sells 30 of this package, and the bot never asks for more in one session.
attackStormForts.buyDummyPeasants.help: 5 mock peasants for 1,570 aquamarine. This spends whatever aquamarine the choices above leave.
attackStormForts.aquaKeep.help: The bot buys when the aquamarine store is nearly full, and spends only what is above this amount.

attackStormForts.stockRams.help: 0 buys nothing. When the Storm Islands castle holds fewer than this, the bot buys 1,000 from the armourer.

meadReplaceStorm.sourceReserve.help: 0 fills the Storm Islands castle. Above 0, the bot sends only the mead your main castle holds beyond this amount.

campNoFeathers: No fast horse feathers left. Far camps get the coin horse until there are feathers again.
campNoEventBoosters: The castle holds no event boosters, so the attacks go without them
campTargetOtherEvent: The camp at the coordinates you set belongs to another event:
campRunLimitReached: the attacks per run you set were sent
statusCampDifficultyNotSet: The event has no difficulty yet. Pick one in the game and restart the bot, or choose a difficulty in Event difficulty.
statusCampDifficultyRefused: The game refused the difficulty chosen in Event difficulty, so nothing is attacked. It may be locked. Unlock it in the game or choose another, then restart the bot.
statusCampAttackingOne: Skip mode on the camp at {{x}}:{{y}}, from {{castle}}. Attacks this run: {{attacks}}.
statusCampsAttacking: Attacking {{found}} camps in turn from {{castle}}. Attacks this run: {{attacks}}.
statusCampTargetOtherEvent: The camp at {{x}}:{{y}} belongs to another event. Enter the coordinates of a camp of this event.
statusCampCastleFallback: The saved source castle is gone, so attacks leave from the main castle, {{castle}}. Pick a castle again in the settings.
statusCampRunLimit: Stopped after {{limit}} attacks, the attacks per run you set. This starts again when the event or the bot restarts.
statusCampNoTroops: {{castle}} holds fewer than {{floor}} attack troops. Waiting for troops to come home.
statusCampPlanShort: {{castle}} lacks troops or tools the wave plan names. Waiting for troops to come home.
statusCampsUnreadable: The map showed camps of this event in a form the bot does not know ({{count}} in all), so nothing is attacked. The log names each one.
campsUnreadable: These map entries did not read as the bot expects and are left alone:
campsNoneWanted: The settings rule out every target, so nothing is attacked
statusDaimyoNoRanks: No Daimyo castle rank is ticked, so nothing is attacked. Tick at least one rank.
statusDaimyoNoneFound: No Daimyo castle of the ranks you picked is near {{castle}}. Looking again in {{minutes}} min.
statusDaimyoUnreadable: The map showed Daimyo castles in a form the bot does not know yet ({{count}} in all), so nothing is attacked. The log names each one.
statusDaimyoAttacking: Attacking {{found}} Daimyo castles in turn from {{castle}}. Attacks this run: {{attacks}}.
statusDaimyoCooling: No Daimyo castle can be attacked yet. The next one is ready in about {{minutes}} min.
statusBuyToolsNoCastle: A castle in your tool targets isn't on this account, or isn't known yet. This tries again on the next check.
statusBuyToolsNotArrived: The last purchase of {{tool}} didn't show up in that castle, so buying for it has stopped. The game delivers a purchase to the kingdom and may have put it in another castle.
buyToolsNotArrived: A purchase didn't raise this castle's stock, so buying for it stopped:
wheelSpin.description: Spins the Wheel of Fortune and the Wheel of Unimaginable Affluence with the tickets you hold, one at a time and only while the event runs. It keeps the tickets you set aside and stops at your daily limit.
wheelAffluence: Spin the Wheel of Unimaginable Affluence
wheelMaxPerDay: Most spins a day (0 for no limit)
wheelSpin.wheelClassic.help: A spin costs 30 tickets. The bot never switches to Pro mode and never buys a jackpot, which can cost rubies.
wheelSpin.wheelAffluence.help: A spin costs 1 affluence ticket. The bot never switches to Pro mode and never buys a jackpot, which can cost rubies.
wheelSpin.wheelKeepTickets.help: A wheel stops spinning when a spin would leave it with fewer tickets than this. Each kind of ticket is counted on its own.
wheelSpin.wheelMaxPerDay.help: Counts both wheels together and starts again at midnight UTC. 0 means no limit.
statusWheelSpinBothOff: Both wheels are switched off in the settings.
statusWheelSpinNoWheel: No wheel event is running. This resumes when one starts.
statusWheelSpinNoTickets: There are not enough tickets to spin and still keep {{keep}}. This resumes when you have more.
statusWheelSpinDayLimit: Today's limit of {{limit}} spins is reached. This resumes tomorrow.
statusWheelSpinProMode: The wheel is in Pro mode, which costs far more tickets per spin. Turn Pro mode off in the game and this resumes.
statusWheelSpinRefused: The game refused a spin. This tries again later.
wheelSpinRefused: The game refused a wheel spin:
wheelSpinNoReply: The game did not answer a wheel spin
recruitTools.description: Keeps each castle's troops and tools at the stock you set by ordering them from the barracks and the workshops. It pays only with coins and resources, never with rubies.
recruitTools.troopTargets.help: Pick a castle, a troop and the stock to keep there. When the castle holds fewer, the bot orders more from its barracks, up to the per-order amount each time the queue has room. Only troops paid with coins are listed.
recruitTools.toolStockTargets.help: Pick a castle, a tool and the stock to keep there. When the castle holds fewer, the bot orders more from its workshop, at most 80 per order. Only tools paid with coins or resources are listed. The Toolsmith does the same job for tools, so don't point both at the same tool.
recruitToolsQueueUnknown: A production queue couldn't be read, or the game's answer to an order didn't show it taken, so nothing more was ordered there:
statusRecruitToolsNoTargets: No troop or tool targets are set. Add a castle, an item and the stock to keep.
statusRecruitToolsNotOrderable: {{item}} can't be ordered with coins or resources, so it is skipped.
statusRecruitToolsNoCastle: A castle in your targets isn't on this account, or isn't known yet. This tries again on the next check.
statusRecruitToolsNoAnswer: The game did not answer. Trying again soon.
statusRecruitToolsQueueUnknown: The production queue for {{item}} couldn't be read, so nothing is ordered there. This tries again on the next check.
statusRecruitToolsQueueFull: The production queue is full. This resumes when a slot frees up.
statusRecruitToolsCoinFloor: Ordering {{item}} would take you under your coin floor. This resumes when coins are back above it.
statusRecruitToolsNoResources: Not enough resources to order {{item}}. This resumes when they are back above your floor.
statusRecruitToolsRefused: The game refused to produce {{item}}. This tries again on the next check.
statusRecruitToolsNoBuilding: {{item}} can't be made because a castle in your plan has no {{building}}. Build one or take the row out of the plan. The plan is left as you set it.
statusRecruitToolsBuildingLevel: {{item}} needs a {{building}} of level {{level}} or higher, and a castle in your plan has a lower one. Upgrade it or take the row out of the plan. The plan is left as you set it.
recruitCantMake: A castle in your plan can't make
statusRecruitToolsTargetsMet: Every target is met. This resumes when stock drops below one.
statusRecruitToolsOrdered: Placed {{orders}} orders for {{items}} troops and tools.
